title: VTA Events — Show — payload
description: A client reads one event the VTA holds for its principal, with its access details and its invitations. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: VTA Events — Show — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vta/events/show/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/events/show/0.1#response.

invitations.description: Every invitation of the event, active and revoked, oldest first.
